moa.t: Buffers hydrogen ions, alkalinises serum (sodium-channel blocker toxicity) and urine, shifts potassium into cells

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Sodium bicarbonate, oral, 1 mmol/kg/dose, 2–3 doses per day after meals. · Adjust according to response.

dosing.h: How to Perform a Nasogastric Aspirate

items.t: (6-10 Fr) · (ideally a falcon tube) · (20mL, 10mL, and 5mL) · Sodium Bicarbonate Laboratory request Oxymetazoline · Local anaesthetic · At least 1 sheet or drape · Alcohol
If the pH < 6.5, add 0.3mL of 4% sodium bicarbonate using a pipette or syringe. • Mix well and recheck pH. • If pH still < 6.5, repeat until pH reaches 6-7.

cautions.t: Do not mix with calcium or catecholamines in the same line
Paradoxical intracellular acidosis if ventilation is inadequate

adverse_effects.t: Hypernatraemia, fluid overload, alkalosis, hypokalaemia, hypocalcaemia, tissue necrosis on extravasation
